instruction: Enable dynamic keyboard shortcuts in GIMP to allow customizing shortcuts on-the-fly.

metadata.explanation: This task requires enabling dynamic keyboard shortcuts in GIMP. The evaluator checks the gimprc config file for 'can-change-accels yes' setting. Similar complexity to original task - simple preference toggle.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirement to enable dynamic keyboard shortcuts in GIMP
Getter extracts the correct file (gimprc config from ~/.config/GIMP/2.10/gimprc)
Metric correctly parses gimprc Scheme-like syntax with parentheses and handles comments/whitespace
Expected value (key='can-change-accels', value='yes') is semantically correct for enabling dynamic shortcuts
Postconfig appropriately closes GIMP with Ctrl+Q to ensure settings are saved before verification
Complete coverage: instruction requires one setting, evaluator checks that one setting
Proper error handling in both getter (returns None on failure) and metric (returns 0.0 on errors or no match)
Edge cases handled: empty lines, comments, missing files, parsing errors
